page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left and right margins. Left margin: the year numbers and the abbreviated running head "An.M." at the top. Right margin: the line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. Below the last line: the catchword "mue-". Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the far left are not transcribed.

main_text.p: An.M.In his annis viginti duobus non numerari de-bent anni duodeviginti, quibus Israëlitæ subiecti fuerunt Ammonitis & Philistæis: sed sunt seor-sim computandi, hoc modo,
2740Interregnum Philistæorum & Ammonitarum 5 quintâ seruitute.Iud.10.v.8. fuit annorum 18. Atque hi sunt 18 anni, quos supraadan.M.2517.excepimus.

2789Samson, annos 20.Iud.16.v.31. Anni quadragin-tâ, quibus Israëlitæ Philistinis seruisse dicuntur, Iud.13. numerandi sunt hunc in modum. Integris 15 20 annis, quibus Samson iudicauit, seruierunt. Reliqui 20 anni pertinent ad tempora, quibus Eli populum gubernauit. Neque tamen est, quòd ideo Samsonem cū Andreâ Masio expungamus è numero Iudicum. Nam Scriptura non dicit de 20 Samsone, quòd populum ab hostibus liberauerit, sicut de aliis iudicibus dicit: sed solùm, quòd praefuerit summæ rerum, in statu scilicet reipub. turbato.
2809Eli, de tribu Leui, praefuit annos 40. 1.Sam.4. 25 verf.18.
2818Samuel circa hoc tempus nascitur. Obit enim septuagenarius, anno M.2888.1.Sam.25.
2848Eli frangit ceruicem, accepto tristi nuntio de arcâ Domini captâ. 1.Sam.4.v.15.

2849Samuel, è tribu Leui, praefuit annos 40. computatis annis regni Saulis. Actor.13.verf.21. Iosephus tribuit Samueli soli post obitum Eli annos 12, 35 & ei vnà cum Saule annos 18, & Sauli post Samue-

page.notes: The catchword "mue-" is at the lower right and is uncertain; it may read differently. "Ebzan" is read as printed; the first letters may be a ligature and are not fully certain. The left-margin year numbers and right-margin line numbers are recorded as notes beside their lines. The "An.M." marginal label is recorded as a note. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the far left were left out.
